zh: 页面启动时插件占用的主线程时间减少：设置页、内容搜索、吉祥物、发送动效、对话导航、上下文弹层与封号彩蛋这七个首屏可以缺席的功能离开 `lib/client.js`，各自成为一个块，由插件已有的资产路由 `/dsh-claude-style/assets/` 提供，页面被接管后立即请求、到达后安装。在本地临时宿主上实测（两种产物各载入 20 次取中位数）：`lib/client.js` 从 776 KB 降到 712 KB，前 3 秒的主线程长任务从 713 ms 降到 648 ms，皮肤生效时刻从导航后 298 ms 提前到 280 ms；七个块经 brotli 压缩后共 33 KB，比主产物晚约 5 ms 到达。块与它的 source map 各自按自身内容的哈希命名，浏览器不会把旧的 map 当成新的那份；构建拒绝主产物与块同时携带同一个模块（构建期生成的模块也在其中，它经共享表读主产物里的那一份）。插件更新后请重启宿主：宿主在启动时缓存客户端包，不重启时页面仍运行旧版本，它请求的旧块已被更新替换，这七个功能会关闭，控制台各提示一次。
en: Less main-thread time at page start: seven features the first frames can do without — the settings page, content search, the mascot, the send animation, the conversation navigator, the context popover and the account-hold easter egg — leave `lib/client.js` for chunks of their own, served by the plugin's existing asset route `/dsh-claude-style/assets/`, requested as soon as the page is taken and installed on arrival. Measured on a local scratch host (20 page loads of each build, medians): `lib/client.js` falls from 776 KB to 712 KB, main-thread long tasks in the first 3 s from 713 ms to 648 ms, and the skin takes the page 280 ms after navigation instead of 298 ms; the seven chunks are 33 KB brotli-compressed and arrive about 5 ms after the bundle. A chunk and its source map are each named by their own content, so the browser never reads an older map as the current one; the build refuses a module the bundle and a chunk would both carry, generated modules included — those are read from the bundle's own copy through the shared table. Restart the host after updating the plugin: the host caches client bundles when it boots, so without a restart the page keeps running the previous version, the chunks it asks for were replaced by the update, and those seven features switch off with one console line each.
